beforePause.dialog:
FIELD CONFIGURATION
×
MAKE IT YOURS.
Helmet work lamp

Lights nearby surfaces in front of you, including cover. Switch off for ambient lighting. It does not reveal enemies through walls.

SCENE BRIGHTNESS
1.30×

Raise this for dark cover or lower it for a deeper storm mood. 1.00× restores the original exposure. HUD brightness stays fixed.

TOUCH LOOK SENSITIVITY
1.00×
FIRE DRAG SPEED
1.0×
FINE
DEFAULT
FAST

Adjust only the right thumb while dragging FIRE. FINE makes smaller corrections; FAST makes broader turns. Your scene swipes keep their look speed. DEFAULT restores the original FIRE response. AIM still adds finer zoomed control.

Faster long scene turns

FIRE uses finer small drags and ramps up for longer turns. Scene swipes scale with screen width for quick portrait turns; optional long swipes turn faster. AIM gives finer corrections with a magnified view. Use FIRE DRAG SPEED to tune firing corrections separately.

Tap visible targets to aim

A short scene tap on or near a visible enemy or coil centers a real surface within 36 m. Small finger-position errors are forgiven; nearer cover, the weapon and HUD still block selection. AIM SET confirms an accepted tap; AIM UNCHANGED means no selection was made. Neither promises a hit. The message clears when you drag, fire, switch weapons or leave play. It does not fire or track. Cover blocks selection. Drags still turn normally. Both weapons; using this joins touch-assisted personal bests.

Rifle aim assistance

Rifle assistance helps follow the motion of a target you aim at while FIRE is held. Fine drags stay manual; drag away or lift to release. Cover, defeat or reload cancels follow. Lift and press on a target to acquire again. Includes near-miss shot correction. FOLLOW appears on FIRE; assisted shots use a separate personal best.

Hold-forward auto vault

Hold MOVE forward against low cover to vault. Release MOVE before it starts, or use AIM, to stay behind cover. Auto vault pauses during firing, reload, crouch and held action button. JUMP still vaults manually.

THREAT LEVEL
Recon — more forgiving
Operator — intended experience
Veteran — high stakes

Threat level applies to your next deployment.

GRAPHICS QUALITY
Performance — lower resolution, no shadows
Balanced — recommended
High — sharper, more demanding
MASTER VOLUME
65%
Contextual route help

Shows the next clear ground step while walking. Stops during aiming or firing. Tap MAP to choose a destination. Patrols still matter.

REDUCED CAMERA MOTION

Reduces view bob, recoil movement, and screen effects.

APPLY & CLOSE
↗
